description: Rules compiled at declaration: operators, fields, types, units, variants, and scopes.

cases.description: R's == compiles to strict equality, `===`.
JSONLogic's loose `==` is refused.
An operator outside the dialect.
A path names a field in scope.
An enum value is never equal to a string; the message names is_variant().
is_variant() names a variant of the enum.
is_variant() with a name the enum does not declare.
A field that two variants hold with one type.
A field no variant holds.
Comparing milligrams with grams.
A product carries no unit, so a conversion by hand is accepted.
A field without a unit is exempt.
An invariant is a logical condition.
and() takes logicals, not numbers.
A runtime-only R value cannot be read.
nrow() takes a table or a matrix.
length() of a table is refused; nrow() counts rows.
A comparison takes two operands.
.x is the element of an enclosing all() or any().
all() over an ordered map of matrices, with .x the element.
Strings do not compare by order.
A row rule reads the row's columns.
A row rule's scope is the row; a field of the struct is not in scope.
A computed total in grams from milligrams.
A computed total converted by a factor.
